title: Yes or No? Animal Quiz for Kids with Milo
description:
Yes or no? Play the animal quiz with Milo the bluebird! Is a polar bear's skin white? Can a horse sleep standing up? Can an elephant jump? Does a giraffe have the same number of neck bones as you? Pick your answer, then see the proof and count along.
An interactive yes-or-no animal quiz for kids ages 2-6, with thinking time, counting, actions to copy and a recap at the end.
tags: yes or no quiz for kids
facts: A polar bear's skin is black, and its fur is not white but transparent and hollow (Polar Bears International; SeaWorld).
Horses can doze standing up because a 'stay apparatus' locks their legs; they lie down for deep (REM) sleep (PetMD; Merck Veterinary Manual).
Elephants cannot jump; they keep at least one foot on the ground even when moving fast, and they are strong swimmers (Smithsonian Magazine, 'Ask Smithsonian').
A giraffe has seven neck vertebrae, the same number as a human; each can be about 10 inches (25 cm) long (Bristol Zoo; San Diego Zoo).

segments.name: hello
lines: Hello, friends! I am Milo the bluebird.
Today we are playing Yes or No!
I will ask a question about an animal friend.
If you think yes, give a thumbs up. If you think no, shake your head.
Are you ready? Let's play!

segments.name: polar_bear
lines: Here is the polar bear. Look at that white, fluffy fur.

lines.t: Yes or no. Is a polar bear's skin white?

lines: No! Here is the fun fact. Under the fur, a polar bear's skin is black!
Look closer. Black skin, hiding under all that fur.
exhibit
And the fur is not really white. Each hair is clear, like glass!
exhibit
Say it with me. Polar bear skin is black!
close:host
Can you shiver like you are in the snow? Brrr, brrr, brrr!
Brilliant!

short.title: Polar Bear Skin Is Black! Yes or No Animal Quiz

segments.name: horse
lines: Here is the horse. Clip, clop!

lines.t: Yes or no. Can a horse sleep standing up?

lines: Yes! Here is the fun fact. A horse can sleep standing up!
Its legs lock in place, so it does not fall over.
exhibit
For a big, deep sleep, the horse lies down on the soft ground.
close:horse
Say it with me. Horses can sleep standing up!
close:host
Can you stand very still and close your eyes? Shh. One, two, three.
Wake up! Good job!

short.title: Horses Can Sleep Standing Up! Yes or No Quiz

segments.name: elephant
lines: Here is the elephant. So big and strong!

lines.t: Yes or no. Can an elephant jump?

lines: No! Here is the fun fact. Elephants cannot jump!
An elephant is too big and heavy. It always keeps a foot on the ground.
exhibit
But elephants can walk fast, and they are great swimmers!
close:elephant
Say it with me. Elephants cannot jump!
close:host
Can you jump? Elephants can't, but you can! Jump, jump, jump!
What great jumping!

short.title: Elephants Can't Jump! Yes or No Animal Quiz

segments.name: giraffe
lines: Here is the giraffe. Look at that long, long neck!

lines.t: Yes or no. Does a giraffe have the same number of neck bones as you?

lines: Yes! Here is the fun fact. A giraffe has seven neck bones. And so do you!
The giraffe's neck bones are just much, much bigger. Each one is as long as a ruler!
exhibit
Let's count them. One, two, three, four, five, six, seven!
exhibit
Say it with me. Seven neck bones, just like me!
close:host
Can you touch your neck? Gently now. Nod your head. Yes, yes, yes!
Super nodding!

short.title: A Giraffe Has 7 Neck Bones, Just Like You!

segments.name: quiz
lines: Wow! What a great game. Let's play one more time, super fast!
Get ready!
quiz: Is a polar bear's skin white?
Can a horse sleep standing up?
Does a giraffe have seven neck bones, like you?

segments.name: goodbye
lines: You learned four new things today.
Shiver like a polar bear. Stand still like a horse. Jump, because elephants can't! And nod like a giraffe!
Which answer surprised you the most?
Thank you for playing with me. Bye-bye, friends! See you next time!
